name: Sakhi Niwas - Working Women's Hostel
benefit: - Under this scheme, hostels have been arranged for women to stay in urban areas by paying a nominal fee. - Facilities include: Accommodation, Mess, Library, Gym, TV Hall, Creche, and more.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a woman pursuing higher education or professional training, or a working woman.
